text:
sam (partnerships): quick heads-up: ACME support filed several customer tickets after their marketplace image picked up CUDA 12.2 RC + driver 555.x. symptoms: strange token drift on long-generation workloads, occasional OOMs, and kv cache size mismatches. tagging @maria @gwen @josh to coordinate. INF-4321 created for triage. :eyes:

maria (eng-runtime): can you paste a minimal log + the marketplace image tag? curious if it's a crash or just degraded outputs.

josh (acme-partner): here's what one of our customers captured (sanitized):
```
W kv_cache.cpp:87] kv_cache_mismatch expected=1048576 actual=786432
E model_eval.cpp:212] soft_fail: token_probs NaN encountered in batch 3
I perf_stats: latency p95 increased 2.3x on long seq >2048
```
image: gs://acme-marketplace/redwood/inference:v1.3.2-cuda12.2rc
we can repro internally on NV driver 555.38 + cudnn 9.3.0. looks like an interaction with the new quant kernels shipping in CUDA12.2 RC.

sam (partnerships): thanks. initial ask: do we recommend partners pin back marketplace images to CUDA 12.1 / driver 535 while we build a runtime hotfix? grokging impact for partner marketplace ops.

maria (eng-runtime): yes, that's the safest short-term mitigation. i can prepare a hotfix build that forces the legacy quant path (disables the new kernel selection) and run our canaries. realistic ETA: ~8 hours for build + internal canary, then partner canary once you approve. i'll list exact driver pins we should recommend.

gwen (product): we'll want a coordinated advisory. suggest timeline: internal canary today evening, partner canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC, public advisory after partner canary green. @josh can you freeze image updates in the marketplace until we finish?

ops-oncall: suggested canary plan: 5% traffic for 1h (check perf + correctness), 25% for 2h, then 100%. automatic rollback to previous runtime if kv_mismatch or token drift above threshold. i'll add runbook steps to the incident doc.

josh (acme-partner): we can freeze the marketplace image and schedule partner canary at 09:00 UTC. i'll notify our marketplace infra and CS teams.

maria (eng-runtime): snippet for partner pinning to include in advisory: 
```
# Marketplace manifest override example
ENV CUDA_VERSION=12.1
ENV NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION=535.104
# override runtime selection to avoid experimental quant kernel
RUN sed -i 's/USE_EXPERIMENTAL_QUANT=1/USE_EXPERIMENTAL_QUANT=0/' /etc/redwood/runtime.conf
```
we'll ship the hotfix binary that reads the flag too so the override is a no-op once we publish a validated 12.2-compatible release.

sam (partnerships): @cicd-bot can you open a hotfix branch and run the CI matrix with pinned CUDA 12.1 and CUDA12.2-rc to validate both paths?

cicd-bot: branch "INF-4321-hotfix" created. CI triggered for matrix: [cuda12.1, cuda12.2-rc]. job links: <https://ci.internal/redwood/INF-4321>. :robot_face:

gwen (product): i'll draft a joint advisory and loop in marketing + legal for the marketplace customer notice. keep it factual: recommended pin, ETA for hotfix, and next steps.

josh (acme-partner): appreciated. we'll hold marketplace auto-upgrades and run partner canary tomorrow. once you give the green i'll update customers with your advisory.

sam (partnerships): sounds good. i'll keep this thread as the single coordination point and post the advisory draft in ~3h. please paste any canary signals/metrics here when available. :wave:
